statement: The proportion of SUID cases with documented maternal mental health issues is higher compared to non-SUID deaths within the case series.
rationale: This study explores whether maternal mental health history affects the likelihood of SUID versus non-SUID outcomes within a case series. The design compares proportions among cases without requiring incidence or risk estimates, which would need a denominator source.
prior_art: The closest tested work is C9 and C12 from bedsharing_ms_v7 and SUID_manuscript_v9_clean, focusing on maternal smoking during pregnancy but not directly addressing maternal mental health history. This question remains open as it explores a different aspect of risk factors for SUID.
cannot_establish: This design cannot establish causation or incidence due to the lack of a denominator source. It can only compare proportions among cases.
